title: Verify OrderItem View loads with correct permissions and display settings
description: Ensure the OrderItem View action properly loads the checklist view model with correct permission-based display settings and assignee selections.
preconditions: User is logged in with appropriate Orders permissions
A work request exists with checklist steps configured
User has permission to view checklist items

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a work request and click on a checklist step tab
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step view loads successfully showing questions and controls
manual_steps.notes: Step should show based on workflow configuration

manual_steps.action: Verify the 'Add New Question' link visibility matches user edit permissions
manual_steps.expected_result: Add New Question link is visible only if step is editable and user has CanAddItem permission
Select Checklists link is visible only if step is editable, user can select checklists, and checklists exist

manual_steps.action: Verify the assignee dropdown contains eligible assignees with default 'Select Assigned To' option
manual_steps.expected_result: Dropdown shows 'Select Assigned To' as first option followed by eligible assignees

review_note: UI element names and exact labels need confirmation - code shows logic but not specific UI text

title: Verify OrderItem Save handles validation and permission checks correctly
description: Test that OrderItem Save method validates user permissions, processes answers correctly, and returns appropriate success/failure responses in the JSON body.
preconditions: User is logged in with Orders permissions
A work request with checklist step exists

manual_steps.action: Fill out checklist questions with valid answers and click Save
manual_steps.expected_result: Save operation succeeds. QuestionsSuccess field in response body is true
manual_steps.notes: Must check response body - HTTP status is always 200 even on failure

manual_steps.action: Attempt to save checklist step without required permissions
manual_steps.expected_result: Save fails gracefully. QuestionsSuccess field in response body is false
manual_steps.notes: Permission check occurs before processing answers

manual_steps.action: Save with invalid or missing required answers
manual_steps.expected_result: Validation errors returned in response. QuestionsSuccess is false with error details
manual_steps.notes: Server-side validation should catch invalid submissions

title: GenerateQuestionSavingErrorMessage returns localized error message for permission error
description: Verify that when TrackerResult contains permission error details, the appropriate localized error message is generated.
preconditions: TrackerResult object exists with permission error status

manual_steps.action: Create a TrackerResult with permission error status details
manual_steps.expected_result: TrackerResult is created with PermissionError status
manual_steps.notes: This is typically handled at the service layer

manual_steps.expected_result: Method returns the localized permission error message from Localization.Resources.ServiceStatus_PermissionError
manual_steps.notes: Error message should be user-friendly and localized

review_note: This is a backend method - exact UI manifestation needs confirmation
